# Build CSV content for unique songs across song library, album library, and playlists
unique_song_ids = sorted(list(all_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids count:', len(unique_song_ids))

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

lines = []
lines.append('Title,Artists')

# ensure song_cache has entries for all ids
missing_in_cache = [sid for sid in unique_song_ids if sid not in song_cache]
print('missing_in_cache count:', len(missing_in_cache))

for sid in unique_song_ids:
    info = song_cache[sid]
    title = info.get('title','')
    artists_str = info.get('artists_str','')
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists_str))

content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv content lines:', len(lines))
print('first 3 data lines:')
for l in lines[:4]:
    print(l)
print('last 2 data lines:')
for l in lines[-3:]:
    print(l)
